about: Original items written from scratch on 2026-09-29 (no source question) as controls for eval/gates_selftest.py and as examples of the item format in docs/clean-room-pipeline.md.

mark_scheme.for: Reduces at least one power by one, e.g. $x^3 \to x^2$

parts.label: b
parts.text: Hence find the coordinates of the two stationary points of $C$. (4)

mark_scheme.for: Sets their derivative equal to zero and solves a three-term quadratic
Substitutes at least one of their $x$ values into the equation of $C$

parts.label: c
parts.text: Use the second derivative to decide whether each stationary point is a maximum or a minimum. (2)

mark_scheme.for: Finds $\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2} = 12x - 30$ and substitutes one of their $x$ values
$-6 < 0$ so $(2, 8)$ is a maximum; $6 > 0$ so $(3, 7)$ is a minimum

pitfalls.text: Setting $y = 0$ finds where $C$ crosses the $x$-axis, not where it is flat: put $6x^2 - 30x + 36 = 0$.
The question asks for coordinates, so $x = 2$ and $x = 3$ alone lose the last mark: you need $y = 8$ and $y = 7$ too.

items.stem: A bakery says that $30\%$ of its loyalty-card holders buy a cake on every visit. The new manager suspects the true proportion is lower. She picks $25$ card holders at random and finds that $3$ of them bought a cake on every visit last month.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Write down hypotheses for a test of the manager's suspicion. (1)

parts.label: b
parts.text: Test, at the $5\%$ significance level, whether the manager is right. State your conclusion in context. (3)

mark_scheme.for: Rejects $\mathrm{H}_0$: there is evidence that fewer than $30\%$ of card holders buy a cake on every visit

items.stem: A box $A$ of mass $3\,\mathrm{kg}$ lies on a rough horizontal shelf. It is tied to a light inextensible cord that runs over a small smooth pulley at the edge of the shelf to a weight $B$ of mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$, which hangs clear of the floor. The coefficient of friction between $A$ and the shelf is $0.25$. The boxes are let go from rest with the cord taut.

mark_scheme.for: Equation of motion for $B$ (or the whole system): $2g - T = 2a$

parts.label: b
parts.text: Find the tension in the cord. (2)

mark_scheme.for: Substitutes their $a$ into an equation of motion
